test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following UT/states is Hemkund Sahib located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Hemkund Sahib**:

 
 
• Hemkund Sahib also known as **Gurudwara Shri Hemkund Sahib J**i, is a** Sikh place of worship** and** pilgrimage site** in **Chamoli district, Uttarakhand**.
 
• It is devoted to **Guru Gobind Singh **(1666–1708), the **tenth Sikh Guru**, and finds mention in **Dasam Granth**.
 
• It is according to the Survey of India located in the **Garhwal Himalaya** at an elevation of** 4,160 meters (13,650 feet**).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f7ca76f9ff843abf0ad2525b6dec0c792a6036b80fde2fa4ff437d37d3ba50.png]
